Gideon's corrected figure for Vantorre Group is 280 seats. He first said 300 in the July 1 thread in #strategic-pod. At 9:19 he retracted it. He said the 300 came from a combined staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the active production roster as of July 1.

That number is from July 1, so it may have moved since. If the deck needs a current count, check with Gideon.
